verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's user-management page claims to automate identity creation, access changes, and identity and access termination across the lifecycle, which loosely implies automated provisioning. However, nothing in the evidence names SCIM or describes pushing users, groups, or entitlements into downstream apps when access is assigned. The HRIS integration is inbound (HR system into JumpCloud), and the REST/PowerShell automation is a developer building block, so neither earns credit here. Missing for 10: explicit SCIM outbound provisioning to downstream apps, group and entitlement push, real-time trigger on access assignment, an app-connector catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
